# These variables can be copied to .env for local development
# Copy this file to .env and adjust values for your local setup: cp .env.defaults .env

# Core application environment
NODE_ENV=production # We want to simulate production as close as possible
APP_ENV=production # Application environment (development/production)
LOG_LEVEL=info # Logging level (debug/info/warn/error)
COOKIE_NAME=app-cookie # Name of the session cookie
BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 # Base URL for local development
WEBAPP_APP_TITLE=buildplace.io # Application title

# Database configuration - REQUIRED for local development
DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_dev # Main database connection
MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_dev # Database URL for migrations
TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_test # Test database connection
BYPASS_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_dev # Database URL for bypassing RLS
SHADOW_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_shadow # Shadow database for migrations
TEST_DIRECT_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_test # Direct test database URL
RATE_LIMIT_MAX=10000000000 # Maximum rate limit for API requests

# Redis configuration - REQUIRED
VALKEY_SERVER=localhost # Redis server hostname
VALKEY_PORT=6379 # Redis server port
BULL_PREFIX=local # Prefix for Bull queue jobs

# Web application configuration
WEBAPP_DOMAIN=http://localhost:3000 # Domain for the web application
WEBAPP_SELFSERVING_TILESERVER=https://example.com # URL for tile server
WEBAPP_OGRE_API=https://ogre.example.com # URL for OGRE API
WEBAPP_MAP_MAPTILER_KEY=your_maptiler_key_here # API key for MapTiler
WEBAPP_MAP_GEOAPIFY_KEY=your_geoapify_key_here # API key for Geoapify
WEBAPP_PUBLIC_URL="" # Public URL for the webapp
WEBAPP_SELFSERVING_DGM_TILES=https://example.com/tiles # URL for DGM tiles
WEBAPP_TILESERVER_KEY=your_tileserver_key_here # API key for tile server
WEBAPP_DEV_USER_PW=your_dev_password_here # Development user password

# Security keys - GENERATE RANDOM STRINGS FOR PRODUCTION
SESSION_KEY=your_session_key_here # Random string for session encryption (generate with crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))
STORAGE_KEY=your_storage_key_here # API key for storage service
STORAGE_SECRET=your_storage_secret_here # Secret for storage service
CRYPTO_SECRET=your_crypto_secret_here # Secret for symmetric encryption - REQUIRED for tests

# Storage configuration
STORAGE_BUCKET=dev # Storage bucket name
STORAGE_URL=storage.example.com # Storage service URL

# Mail configuration
MAIL_SMTP=mail.example.com # SMTP server for sending emails
MAIL_NOREPLY_USER=noreply@example.com # Email address for no-reply emails
MAIL_NOREPLY_PW=your_mail_password # Password for no-reply email account

# Self-serving API
SELFSERVING_API=https://selfservice.example.com # URL for self-serving API
SELFSERVING_KEY=your_selfserving_key_here # API key for self-serving service

# Monitoring and observability
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=buildplace # OpenTelemetry service name (used by NodeSDK)
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318 # OpenTelemetry collector OTLP HTTP endpoint

# XPlanBox configuration
XPLANBOX_URL=https://xplanbox.example.com # XPlanBox service URL
XPLANBOX_USER=your_xplanbox_user # XPlanBox username
XPLANBOX_PASSWORD=your_xplanbox_password # XPlanBox password

# Ladybug API URL
# TO-DO: Update this URL for production deployments
WEBAPP_COMFORT_ANALYSIS_SERVER=http://localhost:3100 # URL for Ladybug API===DEVCONTAINER===

# we use apt (debian) here instead of apk (alpine)
ARG VARIANT=24-bookworm
# install javascript nodejs container
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/vscode/devcontainers/javascript-node:${VARIANT}

# Install required system dependencies
# RUN apt add --no-cache python3 py3-pip bash && \
  # pip install 'cjio' --break-system-packages

# Install Puppeteer dependencies
ENV PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD=true
ENV PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium

# add ibm plex font
# Download the .deb package and extract fonts
RUN mkdir -p /tmp/fonts && \
    wget -O /tmp/fonts/fonts-ibm-plex_6.1.1-1_all.deb "http://ftp.debian.org/debian/pool/contrib/f/fonts-ibm-plex/fonts-ibm-plex_6.1.1-1_all.deb" && \
    apt install -f /tmp/fonts/fonts-ibm-plex_6.1.1-1_all.deb && \
    rm -rf /tmp/fonts

RUN apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  # this is for playwright
  xvfb xauth \
  fonts-ipafont-gothic fonts-wqy-zenhei fonts-thai-tlwg fonts-khmeros \
  fonts-kacst fonts-freefont-ttf \
  fonts-noto-core fonts-noto-color-emoji fonts-ibm-plex \
  chromium

# install gdal from Debian packages (GDAL 3.6.2 with PROJ)
RUN apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y gdal-bin libgdal-dev && \
  apt-get clean && \
  rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN apt-get clean
RUN npx playwright install --with-deps
# keep bash history persistent
RUN SNIPPET="export PROMPT_COMMAND='history -a' && export HISTFILE=/commandhistory/.bash_history" \
    && mkdir -p /commandhistory \
    && chown -R node:node /commandhistory \
    && echo "$SNIPPET" >> "/home/node/.bashrc"{

{
  "name": "Buildplace App",
  "dockerComposeFile": "docker-compose.yml",
  "service": "app",
  "workspaceFolder": "/home/node/app",
  "mounts": [
    "source=${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}-node_modules,target=${containerWorkspaceFolder}/node_modules,type=volume"
  ],
  "features": {
    "ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node:1": {
      "version": "latest",
      "pnpmVersion": "latest",
      "nvmVersion": "latest"
    },
    "ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/common-utils": {
      "username": "node"
    }
  },
  // Configure tool-specific properties.
  "customizations": {
    // Configure properties specific to VS Code.
    "vscode": {
      // Add the IDs of extensions you want installed when the container is created.
      "extensions": [
        "biomejs.biome",
        "prisma.prisma",
        "graphql.vscode-graphql",
        "vitest.explorer"
      ]
    }
  },

  // Use 'postCreateCommand' to run commands after the container is created.
  "postCreateCommand": "echo $PWD && bash .devcontainer/setup.sh",

  // Use node user instead of root - VS Code will automatically match UID/GID to local user on Linux
  // it avoids user rights problem on *nix systems when switching between dev-containers and non-devcontainer environment
  "remoteUser": "node",

  "shutdownAction": "stopCompose"
  // Add init property for DevPod compatibility
  // "init": true
}
version: '3.8'
services:
  # Update this to the name of the service you want to work with in your docker-compose.yml file
  app:
    # Uncomment if you want to override the service's Dockerfile to one in the .devcontainer
    # folder. Note that the path of the Dockerfile and context is relative to the *primary*
    # docker-compose.yml file (the first in the devcontainer.json "dockerComposeFile"
    # array). The sample below assumes your primary file is in the root of your project.
    #
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile

    volumes:
      #add commandhistory volume to have persistant bash history
      - dev-bashhistory:/commandhistory
      # Update this to wherever you want VS Code to mount the folder of your project
      - ..:/home/node/app
      #https://code.visualstudio.com/remote/advancedcontainers/improve-performance
      - workspace-node_modules:/home/node/app/node_modules

    # Overrides default command so things don't shut down after the process ends.
    command: /bin/sh -c "while sleep 1000; do :; done"
    network_mode: host
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
  postgis:
    image: postgis/postgis:17-3.5
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgrespw
      POSTGRES_DB: ffy_dev
    network_mode: host
  pgbouncer:
    image: edoburu/pgbouncer
    restart: always
    depends_on:
      - postgis
    ports:
      - "6432:6432"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_dev
      POOL_MODE: transaction
      MAX_CLIENT_CONN: 90
      LISTEN_PORT: 6432
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'pg_isready', '-h', 'localhost']
    network_mode: host
  valkey:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: valkey.Dockerfile
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      VALKEY_PASSWORD: ${VALKEY_PASSWORD:-}
  valkey-persistent:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: valkey-persistent.Dockerfile
    network_mode: host
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      VALKEY_PERSISTENT_PASSWORD: ${VALKEY_PERSISTENT_PASSWORD:-}
    ports:
      - "6380:6380"
volumes:
  postgres-data:
  workspace-node_modules:
  dev-bashhistory:
#!/bin/bash

#####
#
# PNPM INSTALL
#
#####

echo "1️⃣ Install Dependencies"
git config pull.rebase false
# ignore scripts because of yarn
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
# postinstall is skipped due to --ignore-scripts, copy wasm files manually
cp node_modules/web-ifc/web-ifc.wasm web/public/web-ifc/web-ifc.wasm
cp node_modules/web-ifc/web-ifc-mt.wasm web/public/web-ifc/web-ifc-mt.wasm
cp node_modules/web-ifc/web-ifc-node.wasm web/public/web-ifc/web-ifc-node.wasm
echo "2️⃣ Setup DB"
# first time use of prisma needs dlx
pnpm prisma generate
pnpm setupDb
echo "Happy coding..."FROM valkey/valkey:8.1.4

# Valkey instance for BullMQ job queue system
# Uses noeviction policy to prevent job loss when memory is full
# Port: 6380
RUN mkdir -p /usr/local/etc/valkey && \
    echo "maxmemory-policy noeviction" > /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf && \
    echo "port 6380" >> /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf && \
    echo "appendonly yes" >> /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf && \
    echo 'logfile ""' >> /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf

# Create entrypoint script for optional password configuration at runtime
RUN echo '#!/bin/sh' > /entrypoint.sh && \
    echo 'if [ -n "$VALKEY_PERSISTENT_PASSWORD" ]; then' >> /entrypoint.sh && \
    echo '  echo "requirepass $VALKEY_PERSISTENT_PASSWORD" >> /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf' >> /entrypoint.sh && \
    echo 'fi' >> /entrypoint.sh && \
    echo 'exec valkey-server /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf' >> /entrypoint.sh && \
    chmod +x /entrypoint.sh

ENTRYPOINT ["/entrypoint.sh"]
FROM valkey/valkey:8.1.4

# Valkey instance for PubSub (GraphQL Subscriptions) and Caching
# Uses allkeys-lru eviction policy to automatically remove least recently used keys
# Port: 6379 (default)
RUN mkdir -p /usr/local/etc/valkey && \
    echo "maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru" > /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf && \
    echo "port 6379" >> /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf && \
    echo 'logfile ""' >> /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf

# Create entrypoint script for optional password configuration at runtime
RUN echo '#!/bin/sh' > /entrypoint.sh && \
    echo 'if [ -n "$VALKEY_PASSWORD" ]; then' >> /entrypoint.sh && \
    echo '  echo "requirepass $VALKEY_PASSWORD" >> /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf' >> /entrypoint.sh && \
    echo 'fi' >> /entrypoint.sh && \
    echo 'exec valkey-server /usr/local/etc/valkey/valkey.conf' >> /entrypoint.sh && \
    chmod +x /entrypoint.sh

ENTRYPOINT ["/entrypoint.sh"]
